notices: All nine packaged Solidity sources carry MIT SPDX notices.
requirements: Local chain 31337 only; disposable development wallets and assets.
Deploy the shared SLH verifier, then QPool with that verifier and an immutable supported-token list (up to 16). Empty token list creates a native-only pool.
Confirm exact full verifier and pool runtime before enrollment. Pool immutables must match the compiled constructor output.
Back up and verify the separate SLH key before dual-authorized enrollment. Native/ERC20 withdrawals require both wallet and SLH signatures.
No yield strategy, key rotation, recovery or arbitrary calls. Losing either key can permanently prevent withdrawal.
SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s is category 1, not the same parameter/security profile as category 3 ML-DSA-65.
Compilation does not deploy or transact. Deployment must be explicitly reviewed in a local connected-wallet workflow.
